title: CallSession
description: One audio/video call in a chat, transport-agnostic (full-mesh WebRTC or an SFU). Generalises the ad-hoc 'call' Message so a call and its recording are readable across applications: who was in it, when, how long, and where the recording and transcript live. The canonical envelope is written ONCE, on the vault that already holds the chat's canonical Chat envelope (the group's own vault for a group, the chat owner's vault for a 1:1) — never on the caller's vault, which changes from call to call. Every other participant holds a reference-mixin (isReference + canonicalOwnerEName + canonicalEnvelopeId) on their own vault, never a copy. The body carries references and metadata only: media and transcript are w3ds:// file URIs, never bytes.

id.description: Stable call id, shared by every participant's record of the same call

chatId.description: The conversation this call belongs to

transport.description: How the media was carried: peer-to-peer full mesh, or an SFU

initiator.description: eName of whoever started the call

participants.description: eNames of everyone in the call, including the initiator

roomName.description: SFU room name, when the transport used one

endedAt.description: When the call ended; absent while it is still running

durationSec.description: Talk time in seconds; absent when unknown

recording.description: Present only when the call was recorded. References only — no media bytes and no transcript text.

mode.description: Recorded server-side by the SFU, or by a participant's client

mediaUri.description: w3ds:// file URI of the composite recording

mediaSegments.description: w3ds:// file URIs, when the composite was split into parts

mediaIsVideo.description: Whether the composite carries video as well as audio

tracks.description: Per-speaker media, one entry per participant captured

transcriptUri.description: w3ds:// file URI of the transcript

recordedBy.description: eName of whoever started the recording

recordingVault.description: eName of the vault the media and transcript files live on

isReference.description: True on a participant's pointer to a canonical CallSession held elsewhere

canonicalOwnerEName.description: On a reference: the vault holding the canonical envelope

canonicalEnvelopeId.description: On a reference: the canonical envelope's id on that vault

sharedBy.description: On a reference: who wrote the pointer

sharedAt.description: On a reference: when the pointer was written

updatedAt.description: Body version: bumped whenever the body changes, so readers know a cached copy is stale
